# Standing green-burning iron torch

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_groundtorch_green | Source: Forge | Usage: Lightsource | Crafting Materials: Iron x2, Guck x2 | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

The Standing green-burning iron torch is a light source that can be built using the Hammer within range of a Forge. It requires Guck as fuel.
The standing green-burning iron torch can hold up to six Guck at once. With 1/6 fuel, a standing green-burning iron torch will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At its maximum capacity, a standing green-burning iron torch will last for 33 hours and 20 minutes. This duration is the same for the Standing iron torch, Standing blue-burning iron torch and Sconce.

Categorias: Furniture, Light sources
